finding: The load-bearing coupled run-block null is permutation-invariant: permuting completed runs within a fixed q only reorders the margin multiset, so a and R are unchanged in every null replicate, R0=R, and G=a*max(0,R-R0)=0 for every candidate pair. Consequently the proposed mechanism cannot confront its declared obstacle of regime-specific ordering repair.
why_not_repaired: Repair requires changing what is randomized or changing the statistic so the null alters an observation-candidate pairing. That is the core controlled-diagnostic and activation mechanism, so it is an obstacle-hole redesign forbidden to this patch-only gate.
verbatim_step_quote: 5. Apply P_perm joint circular run-block permutations within q and compute R0 and G; output the excess-replicated dominance tensor while preserving candidate coupling and the fixed path.
executed_evidence: Model: three completed onset runs have B-vs-A normalized margins [1,1,1]. Code excerpt: for each permutation, permuted=[runs[k] for k in perm]; append pair_stats(permuted,B,A).R; then R0=mean(permuted R) and G=a*max(0,R-R0). Executed output: observed_R_B_vs_A=1.0; unique_permuted_R_B_vs_A=[1.0]; R0_B_vs_A=1.0; G_B_vs_A=0.0; all_G_zero=True; scores_A_B_C=[0.0,0.0,0.0]. The arithmetic is permutation-independent: a bijection of whole runs preserves the multiset of m values, and both median(a) and sign-match fraction(R) are symmetric functions of that multiset.
structural_requirement: (a) Identifying condition: any replacement must create a null contrast that can change the pairing between observation-derived regime/run evidence and candidate-field evidence while preserving the constraints claimed essential, so the observed replication statistic is not algebraically invariant under the null. (b) Available sources are timestamped h/q, completed-run boundaries, Lsrc/Lcar fields, candidate identities, and the frozen realized path. Source truth is excluded until evaluation; iid sample shuffling is excluded because it breaks within-run dependence and adaptive-path structure. A bijection of intact runs within the same q is available but insufficient for this symmetric statistic, as the execution proves. The evidence here does not establish which alternative constrained randomization is valid or affordable. (c) Salvage: retain the bounded source-over-carrier e instrument, causal completed-run ledger, multiset-preserving reassignment interface, frozen-path arm structure, and sequestered-truth evaluator; discard the present R0/G activation construction. No executed evidence supports a concrete replacement null.
